steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Definition: Evaluation means making judgements about a text and supporting your opinions with evidence. You assess how successfully the writer achieves their purpose. | Step 1: Decide your overall opinion - agree, disagree, or partially agree Step 2: Find evidence that supports your view Step 3: Analyse how the writer achieves the effect Step 4: Consider alternative viewpoints if appropriate Step 5: Reach a conclusion | Examiner's Tip: This is worth 20 marks - the most on the paper. Spend about 20-25 minutes on it. Make sure you give a clear opinion and back it up with detailed analysis of the text. | Evaluation Exam Strategy: This is AQA Paper 1 Q4 - the highest-mark question at 20 marks.
